section_summary.extract_value: Study X enrolled 326 middle-aged Saudi women (mean age 49.14 years). Mean BMI was 29.64 kg/m2 and mean body appreciation (BA) was 3.92; BA correlated negatively with BMI (r=-0.237, p<0.01). Mediation analyses indicated BA fully mediated the relationship between BMI and weight loss (WL).

section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports data from a single study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women (no study numbering). It provides sociodemographic characteristics (mean age 49.14 years; 33.4% college or higher per table), BMI (mean 29.64), BA (mean 3.92), and reports a negative correlation between BA and BMI (r = -0.237). Mediation analyses indicate BA fully mediated the relationship between BMI and weight loss attempts.
